col1.title: Why Pretreatment Is Needed
col1.p1: Plating adheres well only when the surface is free of oil, oxide and rust. Pretreatment cleans the substrate in three ways:
col1.p1Strong: degreasing, removing rust and oxide, and activating the surface
col1.p2: Ultrasonic action lifts oil from narrow gaps and threaded holes; HCl acid dissolves rust and oxide film; activation lets the first plating layer bond to the substrate.

col2.title: Scope of Application
col2.intro: Applies to incoming goods before they enter the plating line:
col2.item1: Carry oil and dirt from machining and storage.
col2.item2: Pickled in the HCl tank before activation.
col2.item3: Received, stored, then sent to the line.

s1.title: Goods Receipt and Storage
s1.desc: Goods are received, stored, then sent to the line per the production plan.

s2.title: Ultrasonic Degreasing
s2.desc: Degreasing tank with ultrasonics lifts oil from narrow gaps and threaded holes, followed by a water rinse.

s3.title: HCl tank
s3.desc: Rust and oxide film are removed with HCl acid, followed by a water rinse.

s4.title: Surface Activation
s4.desc: The substrate is activated so the first plating layer adheres firmly, followed by a water rinse.

s5.title: Transfer to Plating
s5.desc: Activated goods are moved to the plating tanks per the order requirements.

col1.title: Plating on Plastic Substrates
col1.p1: Plastic does not conduct electricity, so the surface must be treated before metal plating. ABS goods pass through etching, neutralization and palladium activation, then
col1.p2: A hairline finish can be applied on the nickel-chrome layer when the product requires it.

col2.title: Plating Types
col2.intro: Four plating types on ABS plastic:
col2.item1: Two chrome plating technologies, with a bright glossy surface.
col2.item3: Black surface; hairline finish on nickel chrome when needed.

col3.title: Substrate Materials
col3.intro: The factory plates on these plastic substrates:

col1.title: What Is Vacuum Coating
col1.p1: PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) is a coating method in a vacuum chamber,
col1.p1Strong: depositing a metal layer onto the part surface
col1.p2: HANIN uses PVD for products that need a high-quality aesthetic surface and good durability. Coating parameters are agreed for each product.
